items.name_ja: Globus認証・remote endpoint・vLLMを分離したFIRST
items.name_en: FIRST separates Globus identity, remote endpoints, and vLLM backends
items.timing_ja: SC25論文と現行公開repositoryを確認
items.timing_en: Verified in the SC25 paper and current public repository
items.statement_ja: FIRSTはDjango REST/NinjaのInference Gatewayでrequest認可とroutingを行い、Globus Authでidentity、Globus Compute EndpointでHPC clusterまたはlocal machine上のremote実行、endpoint近傍のvLLM等でmodel servingを担当します。OpenAI互換APIから特定backendを直接選ぶ経路と、連合poolから選ぶ経路を備え、hot node維持、auto-scaling、interactiveとbatchを対象とします。Apache-2.0の公開repository、deployment手順、monitoring、load-test toolがありますが、公開資料だけではmulti-center SLA、公平性、失敗時のexactly-once性、課金、model/data residency保証は確認できません。
items.statement_en: FIRST uses a Django REST/Ninja Inference Gateway for request authorization and routing, Globus Auth for identity, Globus Compute Endpoints for remote execution on HPC clusters or local machines, and model servers such as vLLM colocated with endpoints. Its OpenAI-compatible API can route directly to a named backend or select from a federated pool, targeting hot-node retention, autoscaling, and interactive and batch modes. The Apache-2.0 repository includes deployment instructions, monitoring, and load-testing tools, but public material does not establish a multi-center SLA, fairness, exactly-once failure behavior, charging, or guaranteed model and data residency.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIの共通推論serviceでは、portalだけを統合するのではなく、identityとallocationを保ったまま各centerのbackendへroutingできるcontrol plane候補です。
items.hpci_relevance_en: For an HPCI inference service, this is a candidate control-plane pattern that routes to center-specific backends while preserving identity and allocations rather than only unifying a portal.
adoption_conditions_ja: user/project identity、scope、endpoint、model、data path、request IDをend-to-endで監査する。
center別capacity、policy、cost、model license、data residencyをrouting制約へ組み込む。
adoption_conditions_en: Audit user and project identity, scopes, endpoints, models, data paths, and request IDs end to end.
Define queue, cold-start, retry, duplicate, timeout, cancellation, and partial-stream semantics.
Encode center capacity, policy, cost, model licensing, and data residency as routing constraints.

items.name_ja: model状態、最大15万request batch、cluster別機能差の公開
items.name_en: Published model states, batches of up to 150,000 requests, and cluster-specific limits
items.statement_ja: ALCF Inference Endpointsはmodelを`Live`、`Starting`、`Queued`、`Offline`として表示し、ANL/ALCF credentialをGlobusで認証します。batch serviceは1 file最大150,000 requestで、active ALCF allocationと`/eagle/argonne_tpc`またはworld-readable pathを必要とします。Metisでは現時点でbatchとtool callingが未対応でchat completionsのみです。したがって同じOpenAI互換APIでも、待時間、data配置、tool利用、batch可否はbackendごとに異なります。
items.statement_en: ALCF Inference Endpoints expose model states as `Live`, `Starting`, `Queued`, and `Offline` and authenticate ANL or ALCF credentials through Globus. The batch service accepts up to 150,000 requests per file and requires an active ALCF allocation plus data under `/eagle/argonne_tpc` or a world-readable path. Metis currently lacks batch processing and tool calling and exposes chat completions only. Thus, even behind an OpenAI-compatible API, latency, data placement, tool use, and batch support vary by backend.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCI共通APIは互換と表示するだけでなく、model/backendごとのcapability、queue state、data公開範囲、allocation消費をmachine-readableに公開する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: An HPCI common API should expose model and backend capabilities, queue state, data visibility, and allocation consumption in machine-readable form rather than only claiming compatibility.
adoption_conditions_ja: chat、responses、streaming、batch、embedding、vision、tool call、structured outputの対応matrixを公開する。
private dataをworld-readable pathへ置かずにbatch処理できるproject-scoped data pathを設計する。
adoption_conditions_en: Publish a capability matrix for chat, responses, streaming, batch, embeddings, vision, tool calls, and structured output.
Design project-scoped batch data paths that do not require private data to become world-readable.
Measure time to first token, load time, queue delay, throughput, failures, and allocation consumption separately.
